atlas.gpu.title: GPU
atlas.gpu.summary: 吞吐量处理器:数千个简单通道,以平行主义隐藏延迟,而不是缓存和预测.
atlas.gpu.body:
A CPU spends its transistors making *one* thread fast: deep caches, branch prediction, out-of-order execution. A GPU spends them on **many** lanes of arithmetic. 它通过在飞行中保持上千条线线,并在它们之间免费切换来隐藏记忆的潜伏.

For ML and HPC that trade is ideal. 作品多为密集的线性代数,在巨大的阵列上进行相同的操作. A data-center GPU such as the H100 pairs ~130 [[streaming-multiprocessor|streaming multiprocessors]] with [[tensor-core|tensor cores]] and 80 GB of [[hbm|HBM]] at several TB/s.

**What makes a GPU fast in practice**
- Enough parallel work to fill every SM (see [[occupancy]]).
- Arithmetic intensity high enough to be compute-bound, not memory-bound (see [[roofline]]).
- 留在设备上的数据 。 PCIe transfers are ~50× slower than HBM.

In a cluster, the GPU is one node in a hierarchy: GPU → [[nvlink]] within a server → [[infiniband]] between servers. 大部分集群工程都是为了保持这种等级的繁忙.
atlas.streaming-multiprocessor.title: Streaming Multiprocessor (SM)
atlas.streaming-multiprocessor.summary: The GPU's core building block: schedulers, registers, shared memory, CUDA cores and tensor cores.
atlas.streaming-multiprocessor.body:
An SM is roughly what a "core" is on a CPU, but built for throughput. Each SM has warp schedulers, a large register file, configurable **shared memory / L1** and execution units: FP32/INT "CUDA cores", special-function units and [[tensor-core|tensor cores]].

A kernel launch is split into **thread blocks**. Each block lands on one SM and stays there. The SM interleaves the [[warp|warps]] of all resident blocks every cycle, so when one warp waits on memory another issues.

**干嘛要当接线员**
- SM count × clock sets peak FLOP/s. A GPU throttled to 55% clock (thermal or power) delivers ~55% of the math. See [[power-and-thermals]].
- `DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE` and `SM_OCCUPANCY` (from [[dcgm]]) tell you whether SMs are actually busy. "GPU utilization" in [[nvidia-smi]] only means *some* kernel was running, not that every SM was.
atlas.warp.title: 扭曲和 SIMT
atlas.warp.summary: 32线在锁步处执行. 分散的分支和分散的内存访问需要真正的性能.
atlas.warp.body:
NVIDIA GPUs execute threads in groups of **32 called warps**. This is *Single Instruction, Multiple Threads* (SIMT): the warp shares one instruction stream, while each thread has its own registers.

内核性能主要有两个后果:

1. **Branch divergence**: if threads in a warp take different paths of an `if`, the warp runs *both* paths with lanes masked off. 将控制流统一控制在warp范围内,可以做到的地方.
2. **Memory coalescing**: when the 32 threads read adjacent addresses, the hardware merges them into a few wide transactions. 散射访问乘以内存流量. See [[memory-coalescing]].

Warps are also the unit the scheduler juggles to hide latency. More resident warps (higher [[occupancy]]) gives it more choices, up to the point where registers and shared memory run out.
atlas.tensor-core.title: 调色核心
atlas.tensor-core.summary: Matrix-multiply-accumulate units that deliver most of a modern GPU's FLOPs, if you feed them the right precision and shapes.
atlas.tensor-core.body:
Tensor芯在一个指令中计算出小矩阵产品(如16×16瓦). On an H100 they deliver ~989 dense BF16 TFLOP/s versus ~67 TFLOP/s of plain FP32. 这个差距是[[mixed-precision]]训练默认的原因.

**Getting the FLOPs**
- 使用BF16/FP16(或带有变形引擎的FP8)用于matmuls. FP32 without TF32 never touches them.
- Keep GEMM dimensions large and multiples of 8/16. Tiny micro-batches or very narrow [[tensor-parallelism|tensor-parallel]] shards make small GEMMs that can't saturate the units.
- Keep data flowing from [[hbm]]. tensor核心速度如此之快,以至于许多行动(正常化,激活,注意力软马克思)成为内存约束. 内核聚变,如FlashAttention,就存在这个.

Model FLOPs Utilization ([[mfu]]) is ultimately a measure of how busy the tensor cores are.
atlas.hbm.title: HBM & the memory hierarchy
atlas.hbm.summary: High Bandwidth Memory: stacked DRAM next to the GPU die. 其容量约束模型大小,其带宽约束了许多内核.
atlas.hbm.body:
High Bandwidth Memory stacks DRAM dies beside the GPU on a silicon interposer. An H100 SXM has 80 GB at ~3.35 TB/s. 它下面坐着L2(10 MB),每SM共享内存/L1和注册,每个都较小和更快.

**Capacity** is the first wall in large-model training. Mixed-precision Adam needs ~16 bytes per parameter (weights, gradients, FP32 master copy and two moments), *before* activations. A 7B model needs ~107 GB of state alone, more than one GPU holds. That's why [[zero-fsdp|ZeRO/FSDP]], [[tensor-parallelism]] and [[activation-checkpointing]] exist.

**Bandwidth** is the second wall. Any kernel with low arithmetic intensity (elementwise ops, norms, small matmuls) is limited by HBM bandwidth, not FLOPs. See [[roofline]].

尝试下面的计算器:改变模型,ZeRO阶段和并行性,并观看80GB线的每GPU脚印.
atlas.mig.title: Multi-Instance GPU (MIG)
atlas.mig.summary: Hardware partitioning of one GPU into up to seven isolated instances, each with its own SMs, L2 slices and memory.
atlas.mig.body:
MIG (A100, H100 and later) splits a GPU into up to **7 instances**. Each gets a dedicated slice of SMs, L2 cache and HBM, with its own memory controllers. Faults and memory pressure in one instance don't leak into another, which makes MIG the strongest of the GPU-sharing options. See [[multi-tenancy]].

Profiles are named by compute slices and memory, e.g. on an 80 GB H100: `1g.10gb`, `2g.20gb`, `3g.40gb`, `4g.40gb`, `7g.80gb`. 并不是每个组合都合适。 放置遵循固定的规则,其中的切片可以坐在一起.

**When to use it**: inference, notebooks and CI workloads that need a fraction of a GPU and *must not* interfere with each other. **When not to**: large training jobs. They want whole GPUs and NVLink, which MIG instances can't use for peer-to-peer.

与下面的分区器一起玩, 查看配置文件的包装方式 。
atlas.power-and-thermals.title: 电源和热能
atlas.power-and-thermals.summary: GPUs throttle clocks to stay under their power limit and temperature thresholds, and the slowest GPU sets the pace.
atlas.power-and-thermals.body:
Every GPU has a **power limit** (TDP; 700 W for H100 SXM) and **thermal thresholds**. 当超过时,固件会降低时钟:

- **SW Power Cap**: drawing the configured limit; clocks drop slightly. 经常是故意的。 See [[power-capping]].
- **HW Slowdown / HW Thermal Slowdown**: an emergency brake, typically from overheating (failed fan, blocked airflow, hot inlet air). 时钟可以掉一半.

In synchronous training, one throttled GPU turns into a cluster-wide slowdown. 每一个集体都等着它。 That's a [[stragglers|straggler]].

**向甚么处寻.**
- `nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE` shows "Clocks Event Reasons" (formerly *throttle reasons*).
- `nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE` shows current, slowdown and shutdown temperatures.
- [[dcgm]] fields such as `DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP`, `DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE` and the clock-throttle bitmask feed alerting.
atlas.pcie.title: PCIe
atlas.pcie.summary: The general-purpose bus between CPU, GPU, NIC and NVMe. Ubiquitous, but an order of magnitude slower than NVLink.
atlas.pcie.body:
PCI Express connects GPUs to the host CPU, NICs and storage. 一个Gen5 x16链接移动~64 GB/s每个方向. Gen4 x16 移动~32 GB/s. 这足以装入数据,但训练期间GPU到GPU的流量缓慢.

**何必这么重要?**
- GPUs without [[nvlink]] (e.g. L40S) must do all peer traffic over PCIe, often through the CPU's root complex. [[tensor-parallelism|Tensor parallelism]] suffers badly.
- **GPUDirect RDMA** lets a NIC read and write GPU memory directly over PCIe, skipping host memory. Good servers pair each GPU with a NIC under the same PCIe switch. Check with `nvidia-smi topo -m`.
- "Fallen off the bus" ([[xid-errors|Xid 79]]) is literally the GPU disappearing from PCIe.
atlas.nvlink.title: NVLink
atlas.nvlink.summary: NVIDIA's high-bandwidth GPU-to-GPU link: ~450 GB/s per direction per H100, roughly 7× PCIe Gen5.
atlas.nvlink.body:
NVLink is a point-to-point interconnect between GPUs. An H100 SXM has 18 NVLink 4 links totalling ~900 GB/s bidirectional (~450 GB/s each way). Through [[nvswitch]], all 8 GPUs in an HGX server talk to each other at full speed.

**Design rule**: put the *chattiest* parallelism on the fastest link. [[tensor-parallelism|Tensor parallelism]] does several all-reduces per layer, so it lives inside the NVLink domain. Data parallelism, which syncs once per step and overlaps with compute, can cross [[infiniband]].

**Failure mode**: NVLink errors appear as [[xid-errors|Xid 74]]. 一个退化的连线 迫使交通超过PCIe 并悄悄地减缓集体。 `nvidia-smi nvlink -s` shows per-link status, and `all_reduce_perf` (nccl-tests) on an idle node shows the bandwidth drop.
atlas.nvswitch.title: NVSwitch
atlas.nvswitch.summary: 一个切换芯片,将服务器全带宽的GPU每个NVLink送给其他每个GPU.
atlas.nvswitch.body:
Without a switch, NVLink is point-to-point, so GPUs only connect to a few neighbors. **NVSwitch** builds a non-blocking crossbar: in an HGX H100 server, four NVSwitch chips connect all 8 GPUs all-to-all at full NVLink bandwidth.

Newer systems extend the NVLink domain *beyond* a server (e.g. NVL72 racks), so 72 GPUs act like one large tensor-parallel island. The rule from [[nvlink]] still applies: the bigger the NVLink domain, the larger the tensor-parallel or expert-parallel groups you can run without touching the slower scale-out network.

`nvidia-smi topo -m` shows `NV18` (18 bonded links) between every GPU pair in an NVSwitch system.
atlas.infiniband.title: InfiniBand & RoCE
atlas.infiniband.summary: 缩放织物:RDMA网络,在服务器之间移动变位器而不涉及CPU.
atlas.infiniband.body:
Between servers, GPUs talk over a **scale-out network**. 两个家庭占主导地位:

- **InfiniBand (IB)**: a purpose-built RDMA fabric. NDR每端口运行400Gb/s,且耐久性极低,且基于信用的无损失流量控制.
- **RoCE v2**: RDMA over Converged Ethernet. 以太网的同名动词API. 它需要仔细的配置(PFC/ECN)才能保持无损失状态,但网络团队更便宜和熟悉.

Modern training servers attach **one 400G NIC per GPU** (rail-optimized), so each GPU gets ~50 GB/s of scale-out bandwidth via GPUDirect RDMA.

**操作核对表**
- `ibstat` should show every port `Active` / `LinkUp` at the expected rate.
- [[nccl]] logs `NET/IB` when it uses RDMA and `NET/Socket` when it fell back to TCP, a classic silent 10× slowdown (often from `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` or a bad HCA config).
- 一个中途停工的港口会吊死集体 直到NCCL监督时间结束.
atlas.cluster-topology.title: 集群地形学
atlas.cluster-topology.summary: 节点,开关和链接是如何被接线的:脂肪树,铁路优化设计,以及为什么过度订阅会咬到集体.
atlas.cluster-topology.body:
A GPU cluster network is usually a **fat tree**. 叶开关连接服务器,脊椎开关连接叶片. If uplink capacity equals downlink capacity the fabric is **non-blocking** (1:1). Cheaper designs oversubscribe (e.g. 2:1), which is fine for web traffic and painful for all-reduce, where everyone transmits at once.

**Rail-optimized** designs wire NIC *i* of every server to the same leaf switch ("rail *i*"). NCCL's ring and tree algorithms then keep most traffic on one rail, one hop away.

**拇指规则**
- The bandwidth hierarchy (HBM ≫ NVLink ≫ IB ≫ storage) should map onto the parallelism hierarchy. See [[tensor-parallelism]], [[pipeline-parallelism]] and [[data-parallelism]].
- 保持备用能力。 A warm spare node turns a hardware failure into a requeue instead of an outage. See [[checkpointing]].
- 动力和冷却也是地形学。 Racks有KW预算 液冷会改变什么 See [[energy-and-carbon]].
atlas.cuda-stack.title: The CUDA software stack
atlas.cuda-stack.summary: Kernel driver → user-mode driver → CUDA runtime → libraries → frameworks. 版本不匹配在每一个接合处都存在.
atlas.cuda-stack.body:
从下而上:

1. **Kernel module** (`nvidia.ko` and friends). 它拥有硬件,内存管理(包括统一内存/UVM),中断和错误报告. NVIDIA publishes an **open-source** version, *open-gpu-kernel-modules*, the default for Turing and newer GPUs. The [[xid-errors|Xid]] messages you read in `dmesg` come from here.
2. **User-mode driver** (`libcuda.so`): the CUDA *driver API*, shipped with the driver.
3. **CUDA runtime and toolkit** (`libcudart`, `nvcc`): what applications compile against.
4. **Libraries**: cuBLAS, cuDNN, [[nccl|NCCL]], CUTLASS.
5. **Frameworks**: PyTorch, JAX, plus higher-level tooling.

**Compatibility rule**: a newer driver runs older CUDA runtimes, but not the reverse. `nvidia-smi` prints the driver version and the *maximum* CUDA version it supports. 集装箱捆绑自己的运行时间,但必须使用由NVIDIA集装箱工具包注入的东道主驱动器。 See [[containers-and-gpus]].
atlas.cuda-streams.title: CUDA streams & async execution
atlas.cuda-streams.summary: Queues of GPU work that let copies, kernels and communication overlap instead of waiting on each other.
atlas.cuda-streams.body:
A **stream** is an ordered queue of GPU operations. Work in different streams can run concurrently: a host-to-device copy in one, a kernel in another, an NCCL collective in a third. **Events** express dependencies between streams without blocking the CPU.

这是每次"重叠"优化背后的机制:
- Gradient all-reduce overlapping with the backward pass in [[data-parallelism|DDP]] uses a separate communication stream.
- Prefetching the next batch while the current one computes (see [[input-pipeline]]).
- ZeRO-3/FSDP预选下一层的参数(见[[zero-fsdp]]).

Projects such as **grCUDA** go further. 他们从数据中构建依赖图,每个内核触碰后自动将独立的内核排在独立的流上,所以多块块程序在没有手写流码的情况下获得通量.

*Pitfall*: any implicit synchronization (`cudaDeviceSynchronize`, `.item()` in PyTorch, pageable memory copies) collapses your carefully built overlap back into serial execution.
atlas.nccl.title: NCCL
atlas.nccl.summary: NVIDIA集体通信库:地貌意识all-reduce,all-gather和朋友超过NVLink,PCIe和RDMA.
atlas.nccl.body:
NCCL ("nickel") implements the collectives distributed training runs on: all-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter, broadcast and send/recv. It discovers the topology (NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe, NICs) and builds **rings** and **trees** to use it. See [[all-reduce]].

**值得了解的环境变量**
- `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` prints the chosen transport and channels. 念诵.
- `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` forces TCP sockets instead of InfiniBand. 它对笔记本电脑有用,生产上也发生了灾难.
- `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` / `NCCL_IB_HCA` select interfaces.

**诊断**
- `all_reduce_perf` from *nccl-tests* measures achievable *bus bandwidth*. 在闲置节点上运行,以便在用户之前捕捉不良链接.
- Hung collectives end with a PyTorch **watchdog timeout**. The cause is usually one bad rank: a dead link, a lost GPU or a [[stragglers|straggler]] that stopped responding.
atlas.slurm.title: Slurm
atlas.slurm.summary: The batch scheduler that runs most HPC and many AI clusters: partitions, jobs, allocations and node states.
atlas.slurm.body:
Slurm turns a pile of servers into a shared machine. 关键概念:

- **Partitions**: named groups of nodes with limits (`sinfo` lists them).
- **Jobs** are submitted with `sbatch script.sh`. `#SBATCH` lines in the script request resources: `--nodes`, `--gpus-per-node`, `--time`, `--partition`.
- **Allocation**: the scheduler picks nodes (backfill, priority, [[fair-share]]) and runs the script on the first one. `srun` 发射任务贯穿其余部分.
- **Node states**: `idle`, `alloc`, `drain` (finish current work, take no new work) and `down`.

**每日运算符命令**
```
squeue --me                       # what's running / pending and why
sacct                             # history with exit codes
scontrol show job <id>            # everything about a job
scontrol update NodeName=node-3 State=DRAIN Reason="gpu5 fan"
sinfo -R                          # why nodes are drained
scontrol requeue <id>             # restart a job (from its checkpoint)
```
排水有明确的理由,是礼貌地说出"这硬件是可疑的"而不杀死任何人的工作.
atlas.kubernetes-gpu.title: Kubernetes & the GPU Operator
atlas.kubernetes-gpu.summary: Running GPU workloads on Kubernetes: device plugins, the GPU Operator, MIG profiles and gang scheduling.
atlas.kubernetes-gpu.body:
Kubernetes doesn't know about GPUs by default. The **NVIDIA device plugin** advertises `nvidia.com/gpu` as a schedulable resource. The **GPU Operator** installs and manages the whole stack as containers: driver, container toolkit, device plugin, [[dcgm|DCGM exporter]] and MIG manager.

**Differences from [[slurm]] that matter for training**
- Kubernetes schedules *pods* one at a time. Distributed training needs **gang scheduling** (all-or-nothing), provided by add-ons such as Kueue or Volcano.
- Topology awareness (same rack, same NVLink domain) needs extra configuration.
- 它在混合机队中表现优异:推论服务,笔记本和CI在批量作业旁边,常在[[mig|MIG]]切片上.

Many organizations run both: Slurm for large training, Kubernetes for everything else, sometimes on the same hardware.
atlas.containers-and-gpus.title: Containers & GPUs
atlas.containers-and-gpus.summary: How containers get GPU access: the host driver, injected device nodes and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit.
atlas.containers-and-gpus.body:
A container image carries the CUDA *runtime* and libraries, but the GPU *driver* must come from the host (it's a kernel module). The **NVIDIA Container Toolkit** bridges the two. At start it mounts the driver's user-space libraries and the `/dev/nvidia*` device nodes into the container.

**实际规则**
- Pin images to a CUDA version the host driver supports (see [[cuda-stack]]).
- HPC sites often use **Enroot/Pyxis** or **Apptainer** with Slurm. 他们运行的图像没有特权,这是一个巨大的安全胜利。
- Never run training containers `--privileged`. 设备访问权应当以运行时间为限。

**Security angle**: the device nodes *are* the GPU. Anything that can open `/dev/nvidia*` outside the scheduler's control can use the GPU. 这就是未经授权的矿工 如何隐藏在明目张胆。 See [[cryptojacking]] and [[multi-tenancy]].
atlas.data-parallelism.title: Data parallelism (DDP)
atlas.data-parallelism.summary: Every GPU holds a full model replica, processes different data and averages gradients each step.
atlas.data-parallelism.body:
The simplest way to scale: replicate the model on *N* GPUs, give each a different slice of the batch, then **all-reduce the gradients** so every replica takes the same optimizer step.

**Cost**: one all-reduce of the full gradient (2 bytes × params in BF16) per step. With [[all-reduce|ring all-reduce]] the per-GPU traffic is ~2× the gradient size, *independent of N*. 这就是为什么data parallelism的尺寸那么好。

**动作快点**
- **Overlap**: DDP buckets gradients and all-reduces each bucket as soon as backward produces it, hiding communication behind compute (see [[cuda-streams]]).
- **Gradient accumulation**: run several micro-batches before syncing. 你得到一个更大的全球批量 拥有相同的内存 和更少同步每个符号。

**Limit**: every GPU must hold the *whole* model state. 一旦停止装配,请见[[zero-fsdp]],[[tensor-parallelism]]和[[pipeline-parallelism]].
atlas.all-reduce.title: 全减( 环树) (T)
atlas.all-reduce.summary: 将所有队伍的缓冲器 算出结果 数据平行训练所赖以生存的集体。
atlas.all-reduce.body:
**Ring all-reduce** arranges *n* ranks in a ring and runs two phases (reduce-scatter, then all-gather) of *n−1* steps each. 每个军衔都会发送和接收~2(n−1)/n×的缓冲大小:

```
T_ring ≈ 2(n−1)/n · S/B  +  2(n−1) · α
```

where *S* is bytes, *B* is per-link bandwidth and *α* is per-step latency. The bandwidth term barely grows with *n*. 暂时性一词确实如此,它大规模地伤害了小信息.

**Tree** algorithms (NCCL's double binary tree) cut the latency term to ~log₂(n) steps and win for small messages and very large rank counts.

**Bus bandwidth**, the number nccl-tests reports, normalizes away the 2(n−1)/n factor, so you can compare it straight to link speed. A healthy NVLink node shows hundreds of GB/s. 带有退化链接的节点显示PCIe级号.

使用部件来查看大小、 排名计数和带宽如何交换 。
atlas.tensor-parallelism.title: 百日并行主义
atlas.tensor-parallelism.summary: Split each layer's matrices across GPUs (Megatron-style). 巨大的模型适合, 但每一层都需要集体。
atlas.tensor-parallelism.body:
Tensor parallelism (TP) shards the weight matrices *inside* each layer. In the Megatron-LM scheme, the first MLP matmul is split by columns and the second by rows, so a layer needs only **one all-reduce in forward and one in backward**. 注意处理方式相同,即~4激活每个变压器层每micro-batch的全减速.

**权衡**
- ✅ Weights, gradients, optimizer state *and* activations shrink by the TP degree.
- * 交流频繁、对时间有敏感认识,而且走在关键道路上。 大多不能隐.
- Shards)变窄:隐藏/TP太小意味着小GEMMs和较低的[[tensor-core]]效率.

**Rule**: keep TP inside the [[nvlink]] domain (TP ≤ 8 on HGX servers). TP=16 across [[infiniband]] is a classic way to waste a cluster.
atlas.pipeline-parallelism.title: 管道平行主义
atlas.pipeline-parallelism.summary: Split the layer stack into stages on different GPUs and stream micro-batches through. 轻量交通,但泡泡。
atlas.pipeline-parallelism.body:
Pipeline parallelism (PP) assigns contiguous layers to stages. 第一阶段运行1–20层,第二阶段运行21–40层等. Only the activations at stage boundaries cross the network, so PP is comfortable spanning nodes over [[infiniband]].

**The bubble**: at the start and end of each step some stages sit idle while the pipeline fills and drains. With *p* stages and *m* micro-batches per step (1F1B schedule):

```
bubble fraction ≈ (p − 1) / (m + p − 1)
```

More micro-batches (gradient accumulation) shrink the bubble. 互换时间表使其进一步缩小,以牺牲更多的交流。

**Constraints**: the layer count must divide evenly (or nearly) into stages, and stages should be balanced. 第一阶段也拥有最多的飞行中激活.

The classic large-model recipe, **3D parallelism**, combines all three: TP inside the node, PP across a few nodes, [[data-parallelism|DP]] (often with [[zero-fsdp|ZeRO-1]]) across everything else.
atlas.zero-fsdp.title: ZeRO & FSDP
atlas.zero-fsdp.summary: 硬度优化态,梯度和参数跨越了数据平行排名,而不是复制.
atlas.zero-fsdp.body:
Plain [[data-parallelism]] wastes memory: every rank stores identical copies of everything. **ZeRO** (and PyTorch's **FSDP**) shards it:

| 阶段 | 软化 | Per-GPU state (mixed-precision Adam) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 无 | 16个B/段 |
| 1 | 优化状态 | 4 + 12/N B/param 语句 |
| 2 | + 渐变 | 2+14/N B/param |
| 3 / FSDP | + 参数 | 16/N B/第1段 |

**The catch with stage 3**: parameters must be **all-gathered** before each layer's forward *and* backward, every micro-batch. 用于70B型号为~140GB,每micro-batch移动两次. On NVLink that's fine. 超过400Gb/sNIC 它可以主导这个步骤。

**实用指导**
- ZeRO-1几乎是免费的,几乎总是值得的.
- ZeRO-3/FSDP在节点或快速织物上是绝佳的,并且用于安装一个原本不适合的模型.
- At large scale, mix it: TP inside the node, ZeRO-1 or *hybrid sharding* (shard within a node, replicate across nodes).
atlas.mixed-precision.title: Mixed precision (BF16, FP8)
atlas.mixed-precision.summary: Do the math in 16- or 8-bit formats on tensor cores and keep an FP32 master copy for stable updates.
atlas.mixed-precision.body:
Mixed-precision training runs forward and backward in a low-precision format and keeps **FP32 master weights** for the optimizer update:

- **BF16** keeps FP32's exponent range, so it rarely needs loss scaling. A100/H100的默认值.
- **FP16** needs dynamic **loss scaling** to keep small gradients from underflowing.
- **FP8** (H100+) roughly doubles matmul throughput again. 变形引擎等库管理每10个调速器的缩放.

**Why it's a big deal**: [[tensor-core|Tensor cores]] deliver ~15× more FLOP/s in BF16 than plain FP32 on H100. Training in FP32 leaves almost all of the GPU idle.

**Memory**: weights and gradients in 2 bytes, plus 12 bytes of FP32 optimizer state (master, Adam m, v) gives the "16 bytes per parameter" rule used throughout the Atlas.
atlas.activation-checkpointing.title: Activation checkpointing
atlas.activation-checkpointing.summary: 将前置期间的激活抛出,然后在后置状态下重算:交易~33%的计算量要远为更少的内存.
atlas.activation-checkpointing.body:
后向传播需要前方通道的激活. For a transformer layer with FlashAttention that's roughly **34 · s · b · h bytes** (sequence × micro-batch × hidden), and it adds up fast. A 7B model at micro-batch 4 needs over 70 GB of activations.

**Checkpointing** (also called *recomputation*) keeps only each layer's input, then re-runs the layer's forward during backward. Cost: an extra forward pass, ~33% more compute (8N instead of 6N FLOPs per token). Benefit: activation memory drops to about **2 · s · b · h bytes per layer**.

**Use it when** activations are what's stopping you from fitting the model or a larger micro-batch. **Turn it off when** memory is fine. 纯洁的高层。 Selective checkpointing (only the attention internals) gets most of the savings for a fraction of the cost.

Note that [[mfu|MFU]] deliberately doesn't count recomputed FLOPs, so checkpointing lowers MFU even though the GPU is just as busy.
atlas.roofline.title: 屋顶模型
atlas.roofline.summary: Attainable FLOP/s = min(peak compute, arithmetic intensity × memory bandwidth). 告诉你你打的是什么墙
atlas.roofline.body:
Every kernel has an **arithmetic intensity** (AI): FLOPs performed per byte moved from memory. The roofline says:

```
attainable FLOP/s = min( peak FLOP/s ,  AI × memory bandwidth )
```

在log-log轴上标注,然后得到一个斜面的"摩托屋顶"在**山脊点**处与一个平坦的"模拟屋顶"相遇. For an H100 in BF16 that's ~989 TFLOP/s ÷ 3.35 TB/s ≈ **295 FLOPs/byte**.

- 元素化操作(添加,GELU,层规范)有AI大约1. They're hopelessly memory-bound, so **fuse** them.
- 大马特穆尔有AI在上千。 They're compute-bound, and that's where [[tensor-core|tensor cores]] shine.
- 不聚变的注意力是内存的。 FlashAttention restructures it to stay on-chip.

The PRACE GPGPU guide uses the same reasoning for HPC kernels: first decide which roof you're under, then optimize for *that* resource.
atlas.mfu.title: MFU (Model FLOPs Utilization)
atlas.mfu.summary: Useful model FLOPs per second divided by the hardware's peak. 培训效率的诚实头条号码。
atlas.mfu.body:
For dense transformers, training costs about **6 × parameters × tokens** FLOPs (2 forward + 4 backward). MFU compares what you achieved to the theoretical peak:

```
MFU = (6 · N · tokens_per_second) / (num_GPUs · peak_FLOP/s)
```

It deliberately ignores recomputation from [[activation-checkpointing]] (that's *HFU*, hardware FLOPs utilization), so it only rewards useful work.

**What's good?** 35–55% is typical for well-tuned large-model training on H100-class clusters. 超过60%是优秀的。

**What drags it down**: small micro-batches, exposed communication (no overlap), pipeline bubbles, data-loader stalls, [[stragglers]], throttled clocks and plain FP32. The *Feed the Beast* mission walks through these in order.
atlas.scaling-efficiency.title: 提高效率
atlas.scaling-efficiency.summary: Why 2× the GPUs rarely gives 2× the speed: serial work, communication and synchronization (Amdahl's law and friends).
atlas.scaling-efficiency.body:
**Amdahl's law**: if a fraction *s* of the work is serial, the speedup on *n* workers is at most 1 / (s + (1−s)/n). 连5%的连载工作都让你在20××速度上封顶.

Distributed training adds **communication that grows with scale**: collective latency terms, cross-rack hops, and the growing chance that *some* GPU is slow (see [[stragglers]]).

**弱与强缩**
- *Strong scaling*: same problem, more GPUs. 随着每个GPU的工作收缩,效率下降.
- *Weak scaling*: grow the batch with the GPU count. 更友好的是,这就是为什么在仍然一致的范围内存在大批量训练的原因。

**Measuring it**: scaling efficiency = (throughput at n) / (n × throughput at 1). Report it alongside [[mfu|MFU]]. A job can scale perfectly and still be inefficient per GPU.
atlas.memory-coalescing.title: 内存连接
atlas.memory-coalescing.summary: When a warp's 32 threads read adjacent addresses, the hardware merges them into a few wide transactions.
atlas.memory-coalescing.body:
全球内存按对齐区段(32字节区段,分组为128字节线)访问. If the 32 threads of a [[warp]] read 32 consecutive 4-byte floats, the hardware serves them with **one** 128-byte transaction. If they read with a large stride, it may need **32** separate transactions, a 32× bandwidth penalty.

**Classic fixes from GPU programming practice (e.g. the PRACE guide)**
- 结构-阵列而不是阵列-阵列结构.
- Have thread *i* touch element *i*, not *i × stride*.
- Stage awkward access patterns (transposes, stencils) through **shared memory**, then write out coalesced.
- Watch for shared-memory **bank conflicts** when you do.

剖析器(Night computing)报告"每个请求的扇区". 理想是4字节负载4
atlas.occupancy.title: 占用
atlas.occupancy.summary: Resident warps per SM as a fraction of the maximum: the scheduler's pool for hiding latency.
atlas.occupancy.body:
Each SM can host a limited number of warps (64 on H100). **Occupancy** is how many are actually resident, limited by each block's use of:

- **Registers** per thread (the register file is shared by all resident warps),
- **Shared memory** per block,
- **Threads** per block and blocks per SM.

Higher occupancy gives the warp scheduler more candidates to switch to while others wait on memory. 但它是一个手段,而不是目标。 Many fast kernels (big GEMMs, FlashAttention) run at *low* occupancy, using registers and shared memory for data reuse instead.

**Practical approach** (from CUDA and PRACE best practice): use the occupancy calculator or Nsight Compute to see the limiting resource, try a few block sizes (multiples of 32), and measure. 别猜了
atlas.input-pipeline.title: 输入管道
atlas.input-pipeline.summary: Reading, decoding and tokenizing data fast enough to keep the GPUs fed: the bottleneck after you fix everything else.
atlas.input-pipeline.body:
一旦模型数学速度快,CPU侧经常成为极限:从存储,解压,标注,洗涤和拼接批次读出硬块.

**Symptoms**: GPU utilization saw-tooths, step time doesn't improve when you optimize the model, and logs show time waiting on the next batch.

**修补**
- 更多每级数据载体工人(流程),以及固定的内存.
- **Prefetching**: prepare batch *k+1* while batch *k* trains (see [[cuda-streams]]).
- 将机床离线并存储已包装的二进制硬盘。 这是LLM预训单项最大赢球.
- Make sure the parallel filesystem or object store can deliver the aggregate bandwidth: *GPUs × tokens/s × bytes per token*, plus checkpoint traffic.

The *Feed the Beast* mission shows the bottleneck moving to data loading the moment communication is fixed.
atlas.nvidia-smi.title: nvidia-smi
atlas.nvidia-smi.summary: 你接触到的第一个工具是:每GPU的利用率,内存,温度,功率,时钟,过程和配置.
atlas.nvidia-smi.body:
`nvidia-smi` talks to the driver through NVML. The default table shows each GPU's temperature, power draw versus cap, memory use, utilization and the processes using it.

**回答真正问题的观点**
```
nvidia-smi                                   # overview + processes
nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE                 # why are clocks low? (event reasons)
nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,POWER,ECC       # thermals, power limits, memory errors
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,temperature.gpu,clocks.sm,power.draw --format=csv
nvidia-smi topo -m                           # NVLink/PCIe/NIC topology matrix
nvidia-smi nvlink -s                         # per-link NVLink status
sudo nvidia-smi -pl 500                      # set a power limit
```

**Caveat**: "GPU-Util" means *a kernel was running* during the sample window. 这并不意味着GPU很忙。 一个GPU在障碍物等待一个[[stragglers|straggler]]仍然旋转. For real saturation metrics use [[dcgm]] profiling fields such as SM activity and tensor pipe activity.
atlas.dcgm.title: DCGM
atlas.dcgm.summary: Data Center GPU Manager: fleet-scale GPU telemetry, health checks, diagnostics and policy, the backbone of GPU monitoring.
atlas.dcgm.body:
DCGM runs a host engine (`nv-hostengine`) on each node and exposes:

- **Telemetry fields**: temperature, power, clocks, ECC, NVLink counters, Xid events and *profiling* metrics (`SM_ACTIVE`, `SM_OCCUPANCY`, `PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE`, `DRAM_ACTIVE`).
- **Health watches** that flag thermal, power, memory, PCIe and NVLink issues.
- **Diagnostics**: `dcgmi diag -r 1|2|3`, from quick deployment checks to stress tests. 在节点重新加入池前运行一级,在硬件工作后运行三级.
- **dcgm-exporter** for Prometheus, so it feeds Grafana dashboards and alert rules.

**第一天的警报**
- Any [[xid-errors|Xid]] event (critical ones page someone).
- HW热减速活动超过一分钟.
- Uncorrectable [[ecc-errors|ECC]] or pending row remap.
- GPU busy while the scheduler shows *no job* on that node. That catches leaks *and* [[cryptojacking]].
atlas.xid-errors.title: Xid errors
atlas.xid-errors.summary: Error codes the NVIDIA kernel driver writes to the system log when something goes wrong on a GPU.
atlas.xid-errors.body:
An Xid is the driver's way of saying "this GPU had a problem". 它在内核日志(`dmesg`,`journalctl -k`)中作为`NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:xx:00.0): <code>, ...`出现. The messages are emitted by the kernel driver, which you can read in NVIDIA's *open-gpu-kernel-modules*.

**Codes every GPU operator should recognize**
| Xid | 含义 | 典型行动 |
|---|---|---|
| 13, 31, 43 | 应用程序错误( 错误内存访问、 非法指令) | 通常为用户的代码 |
| 48 | Uncorrectable (double-bit) ECC error | Reset GPU, check row remapping, watch for repeats |
| 63, 64 | 重新绘图事件 | 闲置时重置; 如果重映射失败, RMA |
| 74 | NVLink error | 检查链接、 重新座位、 运行 ncl 测试 |
| 79 | GPU has fallen off the bus | 排水管节点,重开,可能硬件票 |
| 94, 95 | Contained / uncontained ECC error | 包含:仅受影响应用. 未装入: 重置 |

**Ops pattern**: alert on Xid via [[dcgm]], **drain** the node in [[slurm]] with the Xid in the reason, requeue affected jobs from their [[checkpointing|checkpoints]], then diagnose offline.
atlas.ecc-errors.title: ECC errors & row remapping
atlas.ecc-errors.summary: HBM is protected by error-correcting codes: single-bit errors are fixed silently, double-bit errors stop the work.
atlas.ecc-errors.body:
Data-center GPUs protect HBM (and on-chip SRAM) with ECC:

- **Single-bit (correctable)**: fixed on the fly and counted. 慢慢增长的计数是正常的。 一个迅速增长的是一个警告。
- **Double-bit (uncorrectable, DBE)**: the data is lost. The application gets an error ([[xid-errors|Xid 48]] / 94 / 95) and the GPU usually needs a **reset**.

A100 and later GPUs use **row remapping**: a bad DRAM row is replaced with a spare at the next GPU reset. `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` shows "Remapped Rows → Pending: Yes" until you reset. If remapping *fails* (spares exhausted), the GPU needs replacing.

**Procedure**: drain → wait for jobs to leave → `nvidia-smi -r -i <gpu>` → `dcgmi diag -r 2` → return to service if clean.
atlas.stragglers.title: 拖曳器
atlas.stragglers.summary: In synchronous training the whole job runs at the speed of its slowest GPU. Finding that GPU is a core ops skill.
atlas.stragglers.body:
每个集体都是障碍。 If one of 1,024 GPUs runs 40% slower (a thermal throttle, a flaky link, a noisy neighbor or a slow disk on one node), **all 1,024** run 40% slower.

**签署**
- 流量下降,日志中没有出错。
- Per-GPU的利用率看起来是*倒转*:straggler显示~100%,其他的则较少,因为他们在屏障上闲置.
- The straggler's SM clock is low. `nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE` shows *HW Thermal Slowdown* or *SW Power Cap*.
- NCCL or framework timing shows one rank consistently arriving late to collectives.

**Response**: identify, drain, restart from a [[checkpointing|checkpoint]] on healthy hardware, and file a hardware ticket. At scale, automate it: continuous per-rank timing plus [[dcgm]] clocks and temperatures, and automatic cordoning.
atlas.checkpointing.title: 检查故障容忍度( F)
atlas.checkpointing.summary: 定期保存模型 和优化状态 所以失败 花费几分钟的进步,而不是天数。
atlas.checkpointing.body:
At thousands of GPUs, *something* fails every few hours. **Checkpointing** bounds the damage: on failure, you restart from the last saved state and lose at most one checkpoint interval.

**Choosing the interval**: too frequent wastes I/O time, too rare wastes compute on failure. A classic approximation (Young/Daly) is *interval ≈ √(2 × checkpoint_cost × MTBF)*.

**变便宜**
- Shard checkpoints: each rank writes its own slice in parallel.
- Async checkpointing: copy to host memory, then write in the background.
- Keep a few recent checkpoints. 腐败或部分储蓄发生.

**Ops integration**: `scontrol requeue` or a job-level retry loop, plus a **warm spare** pool, turns "a GPU died" into a 5-minute blip. 这就是你练习的圈 在*掉下来的巴士*和*慢路 慢路 慢路*。
atlas.multi-tenancy.title: Multi-tenancy & GPU sharing
atlas.multi-tenancy.summary: Time-slicing, MPS and MIG: three ways to share a GPU, with very different isolation guarantees.
atlas.multi-tenancy.body:
Shared clusters must decide how tenants share GPUs:

| 方针 | 隔离 | 不错 |
|---|---|---|
| 整个GPU分配(时间表执行) | 强力 | 训练,一切认真的 |
| [[mig\|MIG]] instances | Strong (hardware partitioned memory and SMs) | 推论、笔记本、CI |
| MPS (Multi-Process Service) | 弱点:共享地址-空间断层会影响他人 | 一个小组的合作工作 |
| 时间划分 | 无内存; 上下文切换器 | 仅测试 |

**Enforcement matters more than policy.** The scheduler should be the *only* path to a GPU: cgroup device controls restrict `/dev/nvidia*` to processes inside a job allocation. Without that, any user with a shell on a node can quietly use idle GPUs. See [[cryptojacking]].

与最低优惠账户对等,没有共享服务用户、审计日志和按租户核算,因此使用率明显公平(见[[fair-share]])。
atlas.cryptojacking.title: Cryptojacking on GPU clusters
atlas.cryptojacking.summary: Unauthorized cryptocurrency mining on stolen GPU time: the most common way GPU clusters get abused.
atlas.cryptojacking.body:
GPUs are valuable, and attackers who get code execution on a GPU node very often just **mine cryptocurrency**. 共同的切入点:

- Exposed, unauthenticated services: notebooks, dashboards and ML tooling UIs on `0.0.0.0` (see [[exposed-notebooks]]).
- Leaked credentials and API keys in images, repos or job scripts (see [[supply-chain-and-secrets]]).
- 过度优惠的容器。

**探测信号**
- A GPU busy with **no scheduled job**: compare [[dcgm]] utilization to scheduler state.
- Unknown process names on GPUs (`nvidia-smi`), often disguised as kernel threads.
- 与采矿池的外部连接(层协议,端口如3333/4444),在`ss -tnp`或防火墙日志中.
- New cron entries or systemd units owned by unexpected users.

**Response**: preserve evidence → kill the process → remove persistence → close the entry point → lock or rotate the affected identities → look for lateral movement → report. 单枪匹马地扼杀这个过程永远是不够的。 The *Night Shift* mission makes that concrete.
atlas.exposed-notebooks.title: 曝光的笔记本和仪表板
atlas.exposed-notebooks.summary: A Jupyter server with no token on 0.0.0.0 is remote code execution for anyone who can reach it.
atlas.exposed-notebooks.body:
Jupyter is designed to run arbitrary code: that's the point. With `--ip=0.0.0.0` and authentication disabled (empty token and password), anyone who can reach the port can run commands as the notebook's user. The same applies to many ML dashboards, experiment trackers and inference UIs.

**更安全的模式**
- Bind to `127.0.0.1` and reach it through an **SSH tunnel** or an authenticated gateway (JupyterHub with SSO).
- 永远不要禁用令牌或密码 。 交通离开主机时使用TLS.
- Firewall compute nodes: only the scheduler, monitoring and admin networks should reach them.
- Run notebooks *inside* scheduler allocations so they're time-limited and accounted.

**Detecting**: `ss -tlnp` shows listeners on `0.0.0.0`. 服务器日志记录出乎意料的IP请求. 网络监控旗入网连接以计算外部的节点.
atlas.supply-chain-and-secrets.title: 供应链和秘密
atlas.supply-chain-and-secrets.summary: 集装箱图像,模型重量和工作脚本是您运行的代码,也是泄露证书的常见地点.
atlas.supply-chain-and-secrets.body:
一项训练任务在很多其他人的代码中拉动:基础图像,Python包,自定义内核,预训重量和数据集. 每一个都是你供应链的一部分。

**风险**
- Images with **baked-in secrets** (cloud keys, tokens) are readable by anyone who can pull them.
- **Pickle-based model files** can execute code when loaded. Prefer `safetensors`.
- 无人依附在你下面会改变

**控件**
- 通过文摘将图像剪辑,扫描,从可信赖的基座构建.
- 秘密经理在跑步时间输入秘密,每个任务范围. Never put them in `#SBATCH` scripts, env files in repos or image layers.
- 短寿命的证书和最小的存储访问特权.
- 校验校验和或签名的权重和数据集。

这些控制保护了*您的双胞胎*集群,以及你负责的数据和模型的人.
atlas.energy-and-carbon.title: 能源和碳
atlas.energy-and-carbon.summary: kWh, PUE and CO₂e: measuring the environmental cost of compute so it can be managed, not guessed.
atlas.energy-and-carbon.body:
A GPU cluster is a power plant's customer. 粗略的核算:

```
facility energy (kWh) = IT energy (GPUs + hosts + network) × PUE
emissions (kg CO₂e)   = facility energy × grid carbon intensity
```

- **PUE** (Power Usage Effectiveness) captures cooling and power-delivery overhead: ~1.1 for the best liquid-cooled sites, 1.3–1.6 for typical ones.
- **Carbon intensity** varies by more than 10× between regions and by time of day. 哪里和何时训练 和如何训练一样重要

**你控制着的列弗斯**
- Efficiency first: higher [[mfu|MFU]] means fewer GPU-hours for the same model.
- [[power-capping|Power caps]] trade a little speed for a lot of energy.
- 右位尺寸:不要让闲置分配运行. 排队者可以收回它们。
- Report kWh and CO₂e per run, next to cost and accuracy, so trade-offs are visible.

Every LazyLab run shows its energy, cost and carbon in the header.
atlas.power-capping.title: 电源封顶
atlas.power-capping.summary: Lower a GPU's power limit and give up a little speed for a lot less energy: often 20% less power for under 10% slower.
atlas.power-capping.body:
Near the top of the voltage/frequency curve, power grows much faster than performance: dynamic power ∝ *f·V²*, and voltage must rise with frequency. Capping power therefore costs proportionally *less* performance than it saves.

在训练中,每步只有计算部分会减慢速度. Communication, data loading and pipeline bubbles don't care about SM clocks, so the real-world throughput hit is smaller still.

**怎么样**
```
sudo nvidia-smi -pl 550            # all GPUs on this node
sudo nvidia-smi -pl 550 -i 3       # just GPU 3
```
Caps reset on reboot unless managed by your provisioning or by [[dcgm]] policies.

**Caveats**: cap *all* GPUs in a job. Capping one creates a [[stragglers|straggler]]. 每焦耳测量指示牌, 不只是每秒指示牌。
atlas.fair-share.title: 公平分配的时间安排
atlas.fair-share.summary: 计时政策,根据各队应享待遇和最近使用的情况,平衡各队的准入.
atlas.fair-share.body:
在一个共享的集群上,"先来,先服务"让一个团队的1000个排队工作让其他人饿死. **Fair-share** scheduling (e.g. Slurm's multifactor priority) lowers the priority of users and accounts that recently used more than their share, with usage decaying over time.

**成分**
- **Shares**: each account's entitlement, often matching funding or team size.
- **Usage decay**: a half-life (e.g. 7 days) so past usage is forgiven gradually.
- **QOS limits**: caps on concurrent GPUs, wall time or job count, so no single job blocks the cluster.
- **Preemption**: low-priority or opportunistic jobs can be checkpointed and requeued when priority work arrives. This only works if jobs [[checkpointing|checkpoint]] well.

Fairness is also about *transparency*: publish usage per team, queue wait times and energy, so allocation debates use data instead of anecdotes.

chapter.running.intro: 只有人们能够可靠和公平地利用一个集群,它才有用。 This chapter covers the software stack from kernel driver to framework, the batch scheduler most HPC and AI clusters run on, the communication library that makes multi-GPU training possible, and the habits (checkpoints, fair share) that keep a shared machine healthy.

mission.first-multinode.title: 两个节点, 一个任务
mission.first-multinode.tagline: 你的第一个多节点训练工作甚至不会屈服. 修补批文.
mission.first-multinode.briefing:
A researcher left you **train.sh**: a 7B training run that should use **2 nodes × 8 H100s**. They say "it just errors out." Get it running across both nodes, and make sure the nodes talk over **InfiniBand**, not the slow management Ethernet.

Useful commands: `cat train.sh`, `nano train.sh`, `sinfo`, `sbatch train.sh`, `squeue`, `cat slurm-<jobid>.out`.
mission.first-multinode.debrief:
**你修好的东西**

1. **Partition**: Slurm rejects unknown partitions at submit time. `sinfo` is the source of truth.
2. **GPUs per node**: `--gpus-per-node` is *per node*. To get 16 GPUs, ask for 2 nodes × 8. Slurm refuses requests no node can ever satisfy ("Requested node configuration is not available").
3. **Transport**: with `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1`, NCCL falls back to TCP sockets (~3 GB/s here) instead of RDMA over InfiniBand (~48 GB/s per GPU). 工作"工作"但运行速度达到四分之一. The tell is in the NCCL INFO lines of the job log.

**Ops habit**: when a job runs but is slow, read the NCCL transport lines before tuning anything else.
mission.first-multinode.objective.0: A training job is running on 2 nodes × 8 GPUs
mission.first-multinode.hint.0: Run `sbatch train.sh` and read the error carefully. Then run `sinfo` to see which partitions really exist.
mission.first-multinode.hint.1: Each node has 8 GPUs, so `--gpus-per-node=16` can never be satisfied. Edit with `nano train.sh`, then Ctrl+S to save.
mission.first-multinode.hint.2: Once it runs, `cat slurm-<id>.out` shows `NET/Socket`: NCCL is using TCP because `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1`. Delete that line, `scancel` the job and resubmit.
mission.fallen-off-bus.title: 掉下来的巴士
mission.fallen-off-bus.tagline: 一个训练工作一夜之间就去世了 找到坏的GPU,隔离节点,再跑一次.
mission.fallen-off-bus.briefing:
Job **101** (a 7B run on 2 nodes) failed a few minutes ago and its owner is asking why. 你的工作是: 你的任务是:

- figure out **which node and GPU** killed it,
- **drain** that node so the scheduler stops placing work there,
- get the training job **running again** on healthy nodes.

Start with `sacct`, the job log (`cat slurm-101.out`) and the node's kernel log (`ssh <node>` then `dmesg`).
mission.fallen-off-bus.debrief:
**Xid 79: "GPU has fallen off the bus"** means the driver can no longer reach the GPU over PCIe. 原因包括动力、热或物理连接问题。 软件无法修复:节点至少需要重新启动,而且经常需要RMA.

**你刚刚做的手术**
1. *Triage from the scheduler*: `sacct` / the job log tells you *which* node.
2. *Confirm at the source*: `dmesg` holds the driver's Xid messages. 开源的NVIDIA内核模块(open-gpu-内核模块)是这些模块的发射地.
3. *Contain*: **drain** the node (running jobs finish, new ones avoid it) with a reason the hardware team can read later in `sinfo -R`.
4. *Recover*: resubmit or requeue. 工作恢复了上checkpoint,如此频繁的checkpoints缩小了爆炸半径.
mission.fallen-off-bus.objective.1: 7B的工作是再次在两个健康节点上训练
mission.fallen-off-bus.hint.0: `sacct` shows job 101 FAILED. The log `cat slurm-101.out` says a CUDA error on node-2.
mission.fallen-off-bus.hint.1: On node-2, run `dmesg | grep Xid`. Xid 79 means the GPU fell off the PCIe bus. 只有重启或硬件互换来修正它.
mission.fallen-off-bus.hint.2: From the login node: `scontrol update NodeName=node-2 State=DRAIN Reason="Xid 79 gpu6"`, then `sbatch train.sh` (or `scontrol requeue 101`).
mission.straggler.title: 慢路 慢路 慢路
mission.straggler.tagline: Throughput just halved across 32 GPUs, but nothing failed. Find the straggler.
mission.straggler.briefing:
7B跑是**4个节点(32 H100s)**上的训练,**节点-5**是闲置的备用车. 几分钟前, 信物下降~45%。 工作日志中没有错误 。 没有坠毁。

In synchronous data-parallel training, every step waits for the **slowest GPU**. Find it, take its node out of rotation and get MFU back above **60%**.

Tools: the dashboards on the right, `nvidia-smi`, `nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE`, `--query-gpu=index,temperature.gpu,clocks.sm`, `scontrol`.
mission.straggler.debrief:
**Stragglers are the silent killer of synchronous training.** One GPU throttled to ~55% clock made *all 32* GPUs wait at every all-reduce. 单扇的吞吐量损失了45%。

**如何发现一个**
- Per-GPU的利用率看起来是*倒转*:straggler被连接到~100%,而健康的GPUs则显示利用率较低,因为它们闲置在障碍物上.
- Its SM clock is low and `Clocks Event Reasons` show **HW Thermal Slowdown**.
- DCGM metrics like `DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS` and temperature are what production alerting should key on.

**Fix**: take the hardware out of rotation (drain), restart from a checkpoint on healthy nodes, and file a ticket for the fan. 一个温暖的备用节点 是它使这个恢复速度很快。
mission.straggler.objective.0: The node with the throttling GPU is drained
mission.straggler.objective.1: The training job is back above 60% MFU on healthy nodes
mission.straggler.hint.0: Look at the topology view: one GPU is hotter than the rest. Or check each node with `pdsh -w node-[1-4] nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,temperature.gpu,clocks.sm --format=csv`.
mission.straggler.hint.1: On node-3, `nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE -i 5` shows `HW Thermal Slowdown: Active`, and `-d TEMPERATURE` shows a failed chassis fan.
mission.straggler.hint.2: 排水节点-3有原因,然后`scontrol requeue 101`. The job restarts from its checkpoint on node-1,2,4,5.
mission.mfu-tune.title: 给野兽喂食
mission.mfu-tune.tagline: 16 H100s running at 26% MFU. 将训练配置超过55% 而不耗尽记忆。
mission.mfu-tune.briefing:
Job **101** trains a 7B model on **2 nodes × 8 H100s**, but Model FLOPs Utilization is about **26%**. The config in **train.sh** was copied from a tiny debugging run.

Get the job to **≥ 55% MFU**. Every flag in the `train.py` line is fair game: `--micro-batch`, `--grad-accum`, `--overlap/--no-overlap`, `--ckpt/--no-ckpt`, `--workers`, `--precision`, `--zero`, `--tp`.

Workflow: `nano train.sh` → save → `scontrol requeue 101` (re-reads the script) → watch `tail slurm-101.out`. Look for OOM errors and the "dataloader wait" marker.
mission.mfu-tune.debrief:
**The bottleneck always moves.** You probably saw it shift from *communication* → *data loading* → *compute*:

- **Overlap**: DDP/FSDP can all-reduce gradient buckets while backward is still running. 没有它,每个梯度同步的字节都会暴露时间.
- **Activation checkpointing** trades ~33% extra compute for memory. 当启动时,它对于大模型和纯废物来说至关重要。
- **Micro-batch size** sets GEMM sizes. Small GEMMs can't saturate tensor cores. Gradient accumulation lets you grow the *global* batch without growing memory.
- **Input pipeline**: once GPUs are fast, CPU-side tokenization becomes the limit. 更多的工人,预托数据或预托数据加以修复.

MFU (from the PaLM paper) counts only *useful* model FLOPs (6 × params × tokens), so recomputation never inflates it.
mission.mfu-tune.objective.0: The 7B job is training at ≥ 55% MFU
mission.mfu-tune.hint.0: Three things are slowing this job: tiny micro-batches, gradient sync that doesn't overlap with compute, and recomputation it doesn't need. Try `--overlap` and `--no-ckpt` first.
mission.mfu-tune.hint.1: After those fixes the bottleneck moves: the log shows `dataloader wait`. One worker can't feed 16 GPUs. Try `--workers 8`.
mission.mfu-tune.hint.2: A bigger `--micro-batch` (2) and `--grad-accum 4` keep tensor cores busy. Micro-batch 4 without checkpointing runs out of memory. 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助) 每GPU内存行.
mission.power-cap.title: 华兹上方
mission.power-cap.tagline: 设施要求停电20%. 保持至少85%的吞吐量.
mission.power-cap.briefing:
Facilities is running hot and asks every tenant to cut GPU power. 7B工作在**2个节点×8个H100s**上,每GPU画~675W.

带上**average GPU power to ≤ 550 W**,同时保留*** 85%的现值**.

GPU power limits are set per GPU with `sudo nvidia-smi -pl <watts>` on each node. `pdsh` can run a command on several nodes at once. 注意电源和吞吐量图
mission.power-cap.debrief:
**电源封顶是数据中心最便宜的效率赢家.**

GPU dynamic power scales roughly with *f·V²*, and voltage tracks frequency near the top of the curve. 所以最后~10%的时钟速度成本~25%的功率. Also, only the *compute* part of a step slows down under a cap. Communication and data loading don't care about SM clocks.

你的结果是 摄入量减少10% 大约减少20%的功率 That is **more tokens per joule**, which means lower cost and lower CO₂e per trained model. 许多网站的训练额占总培训额的70-85%,原因正是如此。

**Responsible-ops lens**: energy is a shared resource. Reporting kWh and CO₂e per job (see the run's footer) helps teams make these trade-offs consciously.
mission.power-cap.hint.0: Power limits are per node: `ssh node-1`, `sudo nvidia-smi -pl 550`, `exit`, then the same on node-2. Or `sudo pdsh -w node-[1-2] nvidia-smi -pl 550`.
mission.power-cap.hint.1: Capping only one node slows the *whole* job, because the slowest GPU sets the pace, and barely moves the average. 都顶上
mission.power-cap.hint.2: 大约500到550瓦左右的吞吐量占85%以上。 过低(<unk>450W),你就会掉下去。
mission.cryptominer.title: 夜间换班
mission.cryptominer.tagline: A GPU is busy with no job scheduled. 调查、控制和消除持久性。
mission.cryptominer.briefing:
Monitoring fired **GpuBusyWithoutJob** on **node-2**: a GPU is pegged, but Slurm says nothing is allocated there. 这是模拟集群上的防御性事件反应演习.

正确装入:
1. **停止未经授权的工作量。**
2. **Close the way in.** Something on node-2 is exposed to the network.
3. **锁上被破坏的账户**
4. **Remove persistence**, so it doesn't come back by itself.

The objective only completes once the GPU stays clean for **2 minutes**. Useful: `ssh node-2`, `nvidia-smi`, `ps aux`, `ss -tnp`, `systemctl`, `journalctl -u <svc>`, `crontab -l -u <user>`, `sudo`.
mission.cryptominer.debrief:
**What happened**: an intern started Jupyter with `--ip=0.0.0.0` and **no token or password**. 任何能到达8888港口的人都可以以`intern`的代码运行. Someone at 203.0.113.77 did: they uploaded a miner, added a **cron entry** to respawn it, and pointed it at a GPU outside Slurm's control.

**为什么每一步都重要**
- *Killing the process* alone fails: cron and the open notebook both bring it back.
- *停止服务*关闭切入点. *Locking the account* stops reuse of the identity.
- *Removing the cron entry* removes persistence.

**Prevention for a shared GPU cluster**
- 千万别直接曝光笔记本 隧道过SSH或使用经认证的网关,防火墙计算节点.
- Enforce that GPU access goes **through the scheduler**: cgroups/device isolation so processes outside a job allocation can't open `/dev/nvidia*`.
- Alert on *GPU busy without a job*. DCGM per-process accounting plus scheduler state makes it trivial.
- 最少的特权, 和审计日志 你实际上读。

In a real incident you'd also **preserve evidence**, rotate credentials and notify your security team. 遏制是第一步,不是终点。
mission.cryptominer.objective.2: 账户“ 实习生” 已锁定
mission.cryptominer.hint.0: `ssh node-2`, then `nvidia-smi` shows a process on GPU 3 that isn't `python train.py`. `ps aux` shows who owns it.
mission.cryptominer.hint.1: 若杀之则复. Check `sudo crontab -l -u intern`, and `ss -tlnp` for a service listening on 0.0.0.0. Then `journalctl -u jupyter-intern`.
mission.cryptominer.hint.2: `sudo crontab -r -u intern`, `sudo systemctl disable --now jupyter-intern`, `sudo usermod -L intern`, `sudo kill -9 <pid>`.
mission.fit-70b.title: 七亿个原因
mission.fit-70b.tagline: A 70B model on 32 GPUs: it doesn't fit. 选择一个并行策略,它能做到,并且运行得很快.
mission.fit-70b.briefing:
你有**4 nodes × 8 H100 (80 GB)**和一个**70B参数**型号来训练. With plain data parallelism every GPU would need ~1.2 TB. 瞬间就变了

设计一个平行的布局,在全部32个GPUs上,**适合内存**并达到**≥ 35% MFU**. Knobs in `train.py`: `--tp` (tensor parallel), `--pp` (pipeline parallel), `--zero 0-3`, `--micro-batch`, `--grad-accum`, `--ckpt`.

Remember: *dp = 32 / (tp × pp)*, NVLink only exists **inside** a node, and 80 layers must split evenly across pipeline stages.
mission.fit-70b.debrief:
**记忆数学先是网络地形学.**

- 混合精度Adam成本~16 B/param:70B×16=1.1 TB 状态*在此之前*激活. 一定有东西能压住它
- **ZeRO / FSDP** shards optimizer state, gradients and (stage 3) parameters across data-parallel ranks. Stage 3 fits anything, but the parameters must be **all-gathered every forward and backward**. 超过400Gb/sNIC 支配你的台阶。
- **Tensor parallelism** (Megatron-style) splits each matmul across GPUs. It needs ~4 activation all-reduces *per layer*, so it belongs on **NVLink inside a node**. tp=16 would push that traffic over InfiniBand.
- **Pipeline parallelism** splits the layer stack. Traffic is light, but it costs a *bubble* of (pp−1)/(microbatches+pp−1). 更多的梯度积累会缩小它。

The common recipe, "TP inside the node, PP across a few nodes, DP (+ZeRO-1) across the rest", falls straight out of the bandwidth hierarchy. That's the core idea of 3D parallelism.
mission.fit-70b.objective.0: A 70B job is training on 32 GPUs without OOM
mission.fit-70b.hint.0: Read the OOM line in `slurm-101.out`: it breaks memory into weights, grads, optimizer and activations. 最佳状态是最大的块。
mission.fit-70b.hint.1: ZeRO-3 across 32 GPUs fits, but it all-gathers 140 GB of parameters over InfiniBand twice per micro-batch. Try it and watch MFU. Tensor parallelism *inside* the node (tp=8, NVLink) is the classic move.
mission.fit-70b.hint.2: `--tp 8 --pp 2 --zero 1` (dp=2) or `--tp 8 --pp 1 --zero 1` (dp=4) both work. 不要设置Tp高于8,或拉诺-平行交通交叉InfiniBand.
mission.pod-design.title: 构建 Pod
mission.pod-design.tagline: Spec a GPU pod that trains a 13B model in two weeks, within budget and the facility's power envelope.
mission.pod-design.debrief:
**Architecture is a constrained optimization**, and the binding constraint moves:

- **L40S**: cheap, but PCIe-only (no NVLink) and less memory per GPU, so tensor parallelism hurts and 13B training lands well past two weeks.
- **A100**: affordable per node, but you'd need ~10+ nodes for the deadline, which breaks the budget.
- **H100 × 5–6 nodes**: makes the deadline. **Ethernet 100G** is cheaper, but gradient sync becomes exposed time and you miss the date. **RoCE 400G** is a legitimate cost-saver over InfiniBand when tuned well.

**Energy matters too**: newer GPUs often win on *joules per token* even when they draw more watts, because they finish so much sooner. Report MWh and CO₂e with every design review.
mission.pod-design.hint.0: Total FLOPs ≈ 6 × 13e9 × 300e9 ≈ 2.3e22. Divide by (GPUs × peak × ~55% MFU) for a quick sanity check.
mission.pod-design.hint.1: A100s are cheap per GPU but deliver ~1/3 of H100 throughput. 数数你需要多少节点, 以及那要花多少钱.
mission.pod-design.hint.2: Try 5–6 H100 nodes. Then compare InfiniBand, RoCE and 100 GbE Ethernet: gradient sync over TCP-class networks shows up in the time.
cp.gpu.0.prompt: How does a GPU mainly hide memory latency?
cp.gpu.0.explain: GPUs trade single-thread speed for parallelism: while one warp waits on memory, the scheduler issues another.
cp.gpu.0.opt.1: 千丝万缕的飞翔中 相互间转动
cp.gpu.0.opt.2: A bigger L3 cache than CPUs
cp.gpu.1.prompt: Roughly how much slower is PCIe Gen5 (~64 GB/s) than an H100's HBM (~3,350 GB/s)?
cp.gpu.1.explain: 3350 ÷ 64 ≈ 52. 这就是为什么数据应该留在设备上,而不是在PCIe上闪烁.
cp.streaming-multiprocessor.0.prompt: nvidia-smi reports 100% GPU-Util. 这能保证什么?
cp.streaming-multiprocessor.0.explain: GPU-Util只表示一些内核是活动. Use DCGM's SM_ACTIVE / tensor-pipe metrics to measure real saturation.
cp.streaming-multiprocessor.0.opt.1: 样本窗口中运行着一个内核
cp.streaming-multiprocessor.0.opt.3: 内存带宽最大值已退出
cp.streaming-multiprocessor.1.prompt: An H100 is thermally throttled to 55% of its max SM clock. Roughly what percent of its peak FLOP/s can it deliver?
cp.streaming-multiprocessor.1.explain: Peak FLOP/s = SMs × FLOPs/clock × clock, so throughput scales with clock: ~55%.
cp.hbm.0.prompt: Mixed-precision Adam needs ~16 bytes per parameter. 一个70亿参数模型在激活前需要多少GB的状态?
cp.hbm.0.explain: 7e9 × 16 B = 112 GB, more than an 80 GB GPU holds, which is why we shard (ZeRO) or split (TP/PP).
cp.hbm.1.prompt: 一个内核对它从内存读取的每8字节进行一个添加. What limits its speed on an H100?
cp.hbm.1.explain: 阿里米特强度 QQ 0.125 FLOP/字节,远低于脊点(~295). 其记脉之脉.
cp.pcie.0.prompt: `nvidia-smi topo -m` shows `SYS` between every pair of GPUs (no NVLink). 哪个平行主义受害最大?
cp.pcie.0.explain: tensor并行主义每层需要若干个全减法. 超过PCIe通过CPU,成为瓶颈.
cp.pcie.1.prompt: Xid 79 says the GPU has "fallen off the bus". 哪辆巴士?
cp.pcie.1.explain: The driver can no longer reach the GPU over PCIe. 这至少是一次重启,经常是硬件票.
cp.nvlink.0.prompt: Which parallelism should live inside the NVLink domain?
cp.nvlink.0.explain: Put the chattiest traffic on the fastest link: TP all-reduces activations every layer.
cp.nvlink.1.prompt: Given this output, which Xid would you expect in `dmesg`?
cp.nvlink.1.explain: Xid 74 is an NVLink error. 交通悄悄地回落到PCIe,集体慢下来.
cp.nvswitch.0.prompt: What does NVSwitch add on top of point-to-point NVLink?
cp.nvswitch.0.explain: Without a switch, each GPU links to only a few neighbors. NVSwitch builds a non-blocking crossbar.
cp.nvswitch.0.opt.3: Links to other servers over InfiniBand
cp.nvswitch.1.prompt: `nvidia-smi topo -m` shows `NV18` between every pair of GPUs. 18是什么意思? 18意味着什么?
cp.nvswitch.1.explain: NV#是保税的NVLinks数量:18架在H100 SXM上,约900GB/s双向.
cp.infiniband.0.prompt: 在一个多节点的工作日志中看到这个. 发生什么事?
cp.infiniband.0.explain: NET/Socket意为TCP. 删除 NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 获取 NET/IB(RDMA).
cp.infiniband.0.opt.0: 所有好: RDMA 正在使用中
cp.infiniband.0.opt.1: NCCL fell back to TCP sockets, so expect a big slowdown
cp.infiniband.0.opt.3: 这份工作已经没有记忆了
cp.infiniband.1.prompt: In a rail-optimized H100 server, roughly how much scale-out bandwidth does each GPU get?
cp.infiniband.1.explain: 400 Gb/s ÷ 8 bits = 50 GB/s per GPU, about a ninth of NVLink.
cp.cluster-topology.0.prompt: 为什么网络过度订阅(如2:1)对培训的伤害大于网络流量?.
cp.cluster-topology.0.explain: 集体是爆裂的,同步的。 每个人都需要全带宽 在同一时刻。
cp.cluster-topology.0.opt.1: During all-reduce every GPU transmits at the same time
cp.cluster-topology.1.prompt: 排序带宽等级, 最快的顺序 :
cp.cluster-topology.1.explain: ~3.35 TB/s HBM, ~450 GB/s NVLink, ~50 GB/s per-GPU InfiniBand, then storage. 将平行的图画在上面。
cp.cuda-stack.0.prompt: A container ships the CUDA 12.4 runtime, but the host driver only supports up to CUDA 12.2. 发生什么了?
cp.cuda-stack.0.explain: A newer driver runs older runtimes, not the reverse. nvidia-smi shows the max CUDA version the driver supports.
cp.cuda-stack.0.opt.0: 工程精细:更新的运行时间总是运行在老司机身上
cp.cuda-stack.0.opt.1: It will likely fail: the driver must support the runtime's CUDA version (unless forward-compat packages are used)
cp.cuda-stack.0.opt.2: 容器安装自己的内核驱动程序
cp.cuda-stack.1.prompt: Where do Xid messages come from?
cp.cuda-stack.1.explain: The kernel module (open-gpu-kernel-modules) logs them to the kernel log: dmesg / journalctl -k.
cp.slurm.0.prompt: Nodes have 8 GPUs and the script asks for `--gpus-per-node=16`. 造成这个错误的最可能原因是什么?
cp.slurm.0.explain: Slurm rejects requests no node can ever satisfy. Ask for 2 nodes × 8 GPUs instead.
cp.slurm.0.opt.1: It requests more GPUs per node than any node has
cp.slurm.1.prompt: 你怀疑节点3的硬件。 如何是礼法解脱门.
cp.slurm.1.explain: Drain lets running jobs finish, keeps new ones away, and records why in `sinfo -R`.
cp.slurm.1.opt.1: scontrol update NodeName=node-3 State=DRAIN Reason="gpu5 fan"
cp.nccl.0.prompt: Which environment variable makes NCCL print the transport it chose?
cp.nccl.0.explain: NCCL_DEBUG=INFO日志 NET/IB vs NET/Socket,频道和地形. 工作迟缓时读之.
cp.nccl.0.opt.3: OMP_NUM_THREADS 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-09-02.
cp.nccl.1.prompt: 工作挂起,然后与进程GroupNCCL 监视超时器一起死亡 。 最可能的原因是什么?
cp.nccl.1.explain: 集体是障碍。 少了一个军衔 就会拖累所有人 直到被监视着的火灾发生
cp.nccl.1.opt.1: One rank stopped responding (dead link, lost GPU, or a straggler)
cp.checkpointing.0.prompt: Young/Daly: interval ≈ √(2 × checkpoint cost × MTBF). A checkpoint takes 2 minutes and MTBF is 4 hours. 几分钟后会来吗?
cp.checkpointing.1.prompt: 在节点失败后重排任务 。 复何处.
cp.checkpointing.1.explain: 自上checkpoint型机车失事以来的工作. 故间断之理.
cp.kubernetes-gpu.0.prompt: Distributed training on Kubernetes needs gang scheduling. 为什么?
cp.kubernetes-gpu.0.explain: Kubernetes schedules pods one by one. Kueue或火山等加载器提供全或无的放置.
cp.kubernetes-gpu.0.opt.1: 所有工人必须一起或根本不是,因为部分人开始陷入僵局
cp.kubernetes-gpu.1.prompt: Which component advertises `nvidia.com/gpu` to the Kubernetes scheduler?
cp.kubernetes-gpu.1.explain: The device plugin (usually installed by the GPU Operator) exposes GPUs as a schedulable resource.
cp.fair-share.0.prompt: A组上周用了3××的股份. 根据公平分享的日程安排,它的新工作...
cp.fair-share.0.explain: 优先级随近期使用量下降,随着衰变(如7天半衰期)而恢复.
cp.fair-share.0.opt.1: 在使用衰减之前获得较低的优先级
cp.fair-share.1.explain: A preempted job restarts from its last checkpoint. Rare checkpoints waste a lot of work.
cp.nvidia-smi.0.prompt: This GPU draws 437 W while its neighbors draw ~650 W at the same job. Which command shows *why*?
cp.nvidia-smi.0.explain: PerforMANCE部分列出时钟事件原因:动力盖,HW减速,热减速.
cp.nvidia-smi.1.prompt: Which nvidia-smi flag sets a GPU power limit?
cp.nvidia-smi.1.explain: `sudo nvidia-smi -pl 550` (add `-i <gpu>` for one GPU). -r resets, -L lists, -q queries.
cp.power-and-thermals.0.explain: HW热减速是热的紧急制动. 电源顶部会显示SW电源顶部
cp.power-and-thermals.0.opt.1: 过热(风扇故障或气流阻塞)
cp.power-and-thermals.1.prompt: In synchronous training, one GPU drops to 55% clock. 整个工作的吞吐量大概...
cp.power-and-thermals.1.explain: Every collective waits for the slowest GPU, so the whole job runs at the straggler's pace.
cp.xid-errors.0.prompt: You find this in dmesg on node-2. 何为对第一答.
cp.xid-errors.0.explain: Contain first (drain), recover (requeue from checkpoint), then diagnose the hardware offline.
cp.xid-errors.0.opt.0: 在同一节点上重新启动任务
cp.xid-errors.0.opt.1: Drain the node with the Xid in the reason and requeue the job elsewhere
cp.xid-errors.1.explain: 这些通常是用户码的缺陷。 Check the job before blaming the GPU.
cp.xid-errors.1.opt.1: 应用程序的代码( 错误的内存访问, 非法指令)
cp.ecc-errors.0.prompt: `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` shows Remapped Rows → Pending: Yes. 有什么需要吗?
cp.ecc-errors.0.explain: Row remapping takes effect at the next reset: drain, wait for jobs, `nvidia-smi -r -i <gpu>`, then run diagnostics.
cp.ecc-errors.0.opt.1: A GPU reset once it's idle
cp.ecc-errors.1.explain: 缓慢上升的计数是正常的。 迅速上升的是一个预警。
cp.dcgm.0.prompt: 哪个警报既能捕捉到泄露的流程,又能捕捉到密码?
cp.dcgm.0.explain: Compare DCGM utilization with scheduler state. 忙着没有工作意味着有东西在运行 不应该是。
cp.dcgm.0.opt.1: GPU busy while the scheduler shows no job on that node
cp.dcgm.1.prompt: 一个节点从硬件修复回来。 在它重新加入泳池之前,快跑...
cp.dcgm.1.explain: 三级诊断包括应激性测试. 1级是快速部署检查.
cp.stragglers.0.explain: 低时钟与高利用率:这是大家期待的.
cp.stragglers.1.prompt: Why do the healthy GPUs show *lower* utilization during a straggler event?
cp.stragglers.1.explain: Inverted utilization (one pegged, the rest lower) is the classic straggler signature.
cp.stragglers.1.opt.1: They finish early and wait at the barrier for the slow GPU
cp.warp.0.prompt: How many threads are in an NVIDIA warp?
cp.warp.1.prompt: Half the threads in a warp take the `if` branch and half take the `else`. 发生什么了?
cp.warp.1.explain: 分支差异将路径序列化。 Keep control flow uniform within a warp.
cp.warp.1.opt.1: The warp runs both paths with lanes masked off, taking roughly 2× the time
cp.memory-coalescing.0.prompt: 32 threads in a warp read 32 consecutive 4-byte floats. 需要多少128字节的内存交易?
cp.memory-coalescing.0.explain: 32×4 = 128字节,完全汇合成一个交易. 一大步可能需要32步。
cp.memory-coalescing.1.prompt: 当内核一次触碰一个字段时, 哪一个数据布局会帮助连接 ?
cp.memory-coalescing.1.explain: 与SoA,线程i读取同一字段的元素i,因此读取的相邻.
cp.occupancy.0.prompt: What limits how many warps can be resident on an SM?
cp.occupancy.0.explain: The register file and shared memory are split among resident warps.
cp.occupancy.0.opt.0: Registers per thread, shared memory per block, and threads/blocks per SM
cp.occupancy.1.prompt: 最高占用率总是最快的吗?
cp.occupancy.1.explain: GEMMs and FlashAttention often run at low occupancy. 量度,不要假设。
cp.occupancy.1.opt.1: 否:许多顶级内核在登记册和共享内存中进行数据再利用交易
cp.tensor-core.0.prompt: An H100 does ~989 dense BF16 TFLOP/s on tensor cores versus ~67 TFLOP/s plain FP32. 大约是几倍快?
cp.tensor-core.0.explain: 989 ÷ 67 ≈ 14.8, which is why training in plain FP32 leaves most of the GPU idle.
cp.tensor-core.1.prompt: Which of these hurts tensor core efficiency?
cp.tensor-core.1.explain: Small matrices can't fill the tensor core tiles and pipelines.
cp.tensor-core.1.opt.1: Tiny micro-batches and very narrow tensor-parallel shards
cp.mixed-precision.0.prompt: Why does BF16 rarely need loss scaling, while FP16 does?
cp.mixed-precision.0.explain: BF16's 8-bit exponent matches FP32's range, so small gradients don't underflow.
cp.mixed-precision.1.prompt: 在混合精度训练中,什么保存在FP32?
cp.mixed-precision.1.explain: 2 B weights + 2 B grads + 12 B FP32 optimizer state gives the 16 bytes/param rule.
cp.mixed-precision.1.opt.1: Master weights (plus Adam moments) for the optimizer update
cp.data-parallelism.0.prompt: With ring all-reduce, what happens to per-GPU gradient traffic as you add GPUs?
cp.data-parallelism.0.explain: 2 (n-1)/n × S 方法 2S。 这就是为什么data parallelism的尺寸那么好。
cp.data-parallelism.0.opt.1: 它保持大致不变(~2×梯度大小)
cp.data-parallelism.1.explain: Several micro-batches, one sync. 每枚硬币的电线上的字节更少.
cp.data-parallelism.1.opt.1: 在没有更多内存的情况下, 增长全球批量, 并减少每个符号同步的频率
cp.cuda-streams.0.prompt: 哪个PyTorch习惯沉默地杀死计算/通信重叠?
cp.cuda-streams.0.explain: . item () 强制设备同步, 崩溃的 Aync 流返回到串行执行中 。
cp.cuda-streams.0.opt.1: 调用训练圈内的. 物品( )
cp.cuda-streams.1.prompt: GRCUDA 如何同时运行独立的内核而不用手写流 ?
cp.cuda-streams.1.explain: 它从内核参数和时间表中构建一个依赖性图表,独立地在独立的流上工作.
cp.cuda-streams.1.opt.1: 它从每个内核接触的数据中推断出依赖性
cp.cuda-streams.1.opt.2: It runs them on the CPU
cp.activation-checkpointing.0.prompt: Full checkpointing costs an extra forward pass: 8N instead of 6N FLOPs per token. 多少额外计算,在%?
cp.activation-checkpointing.0.explain: 8 QQ 6 = 1.33,因此~33%的计算量增加,以换取激活记忆的少得多.
cp.activation-checkpointing.1.prompt: Memory is comfortable, MFU is low, and activation checkpointing is on. 你该试试什么?
cp.activation-checkpointing.1.explain: 当激活适合时,重算就是纯高压.
cp.zero-fsdp.0.prompt: zeRO-1,带有dp=8个硬体,只有12个B/param优化态. 每个参数(2个重量+2个格度+12/8)中的每GPU状态?
cp.zero-fsdp.1.prompt: Why can ZeRO-3 / FSDP be slow across nodes?
cp.zero-fsdp.1.explain: For 70B that's ~140 GB moved twice per micro-batch. That's fine on NVLink, painful over a 400G NIC.
cp.zero-fsdp.1.opt.1: 它在每micro-batch的每个前向和后向前都具有全加太参数
cp.tensor-parallelism.0.prompt: Why keep tensor parallelism ≤ 8 on HGX servers?
cp.tensor-parallelism.0.explain: An HGX NVLink domain is 8 GPUs. 过了它, 耐久性临界流量 击中了较慢的织物。
cp.tensor-parallelism.0.opt.1: TP's per-layer all-reduces need NVLink; beyond 8 GPUs they cross InfiniBand
cp.tensor-parallelism.1.prompt: Megatron-style TP needs how many activation all-reduces per transformer layer per micro-batch (forward + backward)?
cp.tensor-parallelism.1.explain: 一个是注意,一个是MLP 向前,同样的在落后。
cp.pipeline-parallelism.0.prompt: p = 4 pipeline stages, m = 12 micro-batches per step. 泡泡分数 (p−1)/(m+p−1) 单位% ?
cp.pipeline-parallelism.0.explain: 3 ÷ 15 = 20% of the step is idle fill and drain.
cp.pipeline-parallelism.1.prompt: 你怎么消减输油管的气泡?
cp.pipeline-parallelism.1.explain: More micro-batches (gradient accumulation) amortize fill and drain. 互不相干的时间表也有好处。
cp.roofline.0.prompt: H100 BF16: 989 TFLOP/s peak and 3.35 TB/s HBM. Where's the ridge point, in FLOPs per byte?
cp.roofline.0.explain: 989e12 ÷ 3.35e12 ≈ 295. 在它下面,你是内存的, 在它上面计算。
cp.roofline.1.prompt: A kernel with arithmetic intensity 10 runs on an H100. 它能达到...
cp.roofline.1.explain: min(989, 10 × 3.35) = 33.5 TFLOP/s. 引爆行动会提高强度
cp.mfu.0.prompt: A 7B model trains at 500k tokens/s on 32 H100s (989 TFLOP/s each). MFU = 6·N·tokens/s ÷ (GPUs × peak). 在%吗?
cp.mfu.1.prompt: Do recomputed FLOPs from activation checkpointing count toward MFU?
cp.mfu.1.explain: MFU only rewards useful model FLOPs, so it can't be gamed with recomputation.
cp.mfu.1.opt.1: No: counting them gives HFU (hardware FLOPs utilization)
cp.all-reduce.0.prompt: Ring all-reduce of 1 GB across 8 GPUs at 100 GB/s per link, ignoring latency: 2(n−1)/n · S/B. 时间(ms):
cp.all-reduce.1.prompt: Tree all-reduce algorithms beat rings mainly for…
cp.all-reduce.1.explain: 树需要~log2(n) 耐久步骤而不是~2(n−1).
cp.all-reduce.1.opt.0: Huge messages on a few GPUs
cp.all-reduce.1.opt.1: 大规模小信息,即以延迟为主的信息
cp.scaling-efficiency.0.prompt: 阿姆达尔定律:5%的作品是连载的. What's the maximum speedup, even with infinite GPUs?
cp.scaling-efficiency.1.prompt: 1 GPU does 10k tokens/s; 64 GPUs do 512k tokens/s. 提高效率,百分比?
cp.input-pipeline.0.prompt: 你的工作日志上写着这个 什么是最好的第一修补?
cp.input-pipeline.0.explain: The GPUs are waiting on the CPU-side input pipeline, so feed them faster.
cp.input-pipeline.0.opt.0: More dataloader workers, or pre-tokenized data
cp.input-pipeline.1.prompt: 每个工人都给8千个符号做标记。 军衔每1秒需要64k个令牌. 最少的工人人数?
cp.power-capping.0.prompt: 为什么一个电顶的性能比它节省的功率要低呢?
cp.power-capping.0.explain: 最后几百兆赫最贵,所以放下它们可以节省很多瓦特.
cp.power-capping.0.opt.0: 动态功率 QQ f<unk>V2, 电压必须随频率而上升
cp.power-capping.1.prompt: You cap only 1 of the 16 GPUs in a training job. 发生什么了?
cp.power-capping.1.explain: Synchronous training runs at the slowest GPU's pace. 把他们都平整起来
cp.power-capping.1.opt.1: Creates a straggler that slows all 16
cp.energy-and-carbon.0.prompt: IT load of 100 kW, PUE 1.3, running for 24 hours. Facility energy in MWh?
cp.energy-and-carbon.1.prompt: 3,000 kWh on a grid at 0.4 kg CO₂e per kWh. How many kg of CO₂e?
cp.energy-and-carbon.1.explain: 3000×0.4 = 1200公斤 (简体中文). 在较清洁地区从事同样的工作可能要低好几倍。
cp.containers-and-gpus.0.prompt: When a container uses a GPU, where does the kernel driver come from?
cp.containers-and-gpus.0.explain: Images carry the CUDA runtime; the driver (a kernel module) always comes from the host.
cp.containers-and-gpus.0.opt.1: 由NVIDIA集装箱工具包注入的主机
cp.containers-and-gpus.1.prompt: 培训容器应使用`--privileged`运行吗?
cp.containers-and-gpus.1.explain: 私人集装箱可以逃到主机。 GPU access doesn't need it.
cp.containers-and-gpus.1.opt.1: 否: 授权设备在运行时间的狭小范围内访问
cp.multi-tenancy.0.prompt: Which way of sharing a GPU gives hardware-isolated memory and SMs?
cp.multi-tenancy.0.explain: MIG partitions SMs, L2 and memory controllers. MPS and time-slicing share them.
cp.multi-tenancy.1.prompt: 最好的办法是什么来确保GPUs只能通过scheduler使用?
cp.multi-tenancy.1.explain: 执行比政策:在分配之外的进程根本无法打开设备.
cp.multi-tenancy.1.opt.1: c组设备控制限制/dev/nvidia* 工作分配
cp.mig.0.prompt: What's the maximum number of MIG instances on an H100?
cp.mig.0.explain: 计算出7个切片,最多7个1g的例.
cp.mig.1.prompt: Can a 3g.40gb and a 4g.40gb instance fit together on one 80 GB H100 (7 compute slices, 8 memory slices)?
cp.mig.1.explain: 3+4=7计算切片和4+4=8个记忆切片. 一个完美的合身。
cp.mig.1.opt.0: 是:它们一起使用精确的7个计算和8个记忆片
cp.exposed-notebooks.0.prompt: 计算节点上为什么会有这种惊人的症状?
cp.exposed-notebooks.0.explain: 0.00.0表示可从网络中达到。 没有标志,任何人都可以像那个用户一样运行代码.
cp.exposed-notebooks.0.opt.1: 一个笔记本服务器( 远程代码执行) 正在监听所有接口
cp.exposed-notebooks.1.prompt: What's a safer way to use Jupyter on a cluster?
cp.exposed-notebooks.1.explain: Keep it local and authenticated: SSH tunnels or JupyterHub with SSO.
cp.exposed-notebooks.1.opt.1: 捆绑到 127.0.0.1,并使用 SSH 隧道或经认证的网关
cp.cryptojacking.0.prompt: 你杀了一个矿工的过程 一分钟后又出现了 你首先检查什么?
cp.cryptojacking.0.explain: 有东西在重启它。 拆除坚韧性,关上它从里面进来的门.
cp.cryptojacking.0.opt.1: 持久性(cron条目,systemd单位)和原始切入点
cp.cryptojacking.1.prompt: 港口往往表示采矿-联营(地层)交通的出境连接?
cp.cryptojacking.1.explain: Stratum池通常使用3333,4444和5555等端口. Watch for them in `ss -tnp` and firewall logs.
cp.supply-chain-and-secrets.0.prompt: 哪种格式更适合下载模型重量?
